title: Injectivity of the free frequency part
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $J$ be a subset of the coordinates $\\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $\mathcal A$ be a finite family of coordinate subsets, each contained in $J$. The map sending each $U\in\mathcal A$ to its part inside $J$ is injective on $\mathcal A$.
hypotheses_covered: Every member of $\mathcal A$ is contained in $J$
